name: priest_of_the_overlords
description: a Priest of the Overlords, a hooded cultist of the Octopus Overlords: a deep purple hood and a long purple robe edged with teal trim that ends in a wavy tentacle-like hem, his face in shadow with two small glowing cyan eyes and a pale chin, a necklace of cream sea shells, long green kelp strands hanging from the shoulders and down the robe, brown boots, a gnarled wooden staff with a teal octopus wrapped around its top in his LEFT hand, and his RIGHT hand held out with the pale palm open and empty
hands: the octopus staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is held out open and empty

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; hooded head snaps back toward the upper-left, the glowing cyan eyes narrowed, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the open empty right hand flung out to the left, the octopus staff thrown up and out), the kelp strands and the tentacle hem swinging
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent under the purple robe, the octopus staff dipping, the open hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the octopus staff flung up, the open empty hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward under the purple robe, torso slumps forward, hooded head droops, the octopus staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the wooden staff tipped down with the teal octopus at its top resting on the ground, the empty right hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the octopus staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the purple hood on the ground; the octopus staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the purple robe with its teal tentacle hem spread around his legs, the kelp strands lying loose
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the purple robe and kelp strands settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the glowing eyes gone dark under the hood, the octopus staff on the ground beside him
